guide.h2: Council or private pest control in Leeds?
p: Leeds City Council offers pest treatments for residents, with officers who are BASIS Prompt registered and members of the National Pest Technicians Association. Its price includes all the visits needed for the current problem for most pests. The trade off is speed: the council asks you to allow up to 5 working days for contact. Private firms can often come the same or next day, which matters for wasps near a door or rats indoors.

ul: Mice and rats: the most common call out, especially in autumn and winter. Treatment usually needs several visits.
Wasps: nests in roofs, sheds and bushes in summer. See wasp nest removal in Leeds.
Bed bugs: often brought home from travel or second hand furniture. Hard to clear without professional treatment.
Fleas, ants and moths: usually treated in one or two visits.
Pigeons and squirrels: proofing is usually more effective than control alone.

guide.h2: How much does pest control cost?
p: Checkatrade's 2026 guide gives these average UK prices: about £180 for rats or mice over two visits, £137.50 for a wasp nest, £190 for bed bugs and £150 for fleas. See our pest control cost guide for the full list.

ul: Seal gaps around pipes and under doors; a mouse can get through a very small hole.
Keep food in sealed containers and bins closed.
Clear garden clutter and keep compost bins sealed.
Check lofts and sheds for wasp nests in spring while they are small.

guide.h2: Pest control for landlords and businesses in Leeds
p: Landlords are usually responsible for pest problems caused by the building, such as gaps that let mice in, while tenants are usually responsible for infestations they cause. Businesses that handle food need a pest control plan. Leeds City Council offers fixed price annual contracts for businesses, and private firms offer similar contracts with regular inspections.

guide.h2: Signs you need a pest controller
ul: Droppings, gnaw marks or scratching noises in walls or the loft
A steady stream of wasps going in and out of one spot
Small blood spots on sheets or itchy bites in a line, which can be bed bugs
Holes in clothes or carpets, which can be moths

faqs.q: Does Leeds City Council do pest control?
faqs.a: Yes. The council offers pest treatments for residents and businesses. For most pests the price covers all the visits needed for the current problem. Request online and allow up to 5 working days for contact.

faqs.q: How much does it cost to get rid of mice?
faqs.a: Checkatrade's 2026 guide puts rat or mouse removal at about £120 to £240 for two visits, averaging £180.

faqs.q: How long does it take to get rid of rats?
faqs.a: Usually two to three visits over a couple of weeks, depending on how big the problem is and whether entry points are sealed.

faqs.q: Is pest control safe for pets?
faqs.a: Professional pest controllers use bait boxes and products designed to limit risk to pets and children. Tell the technician about any pets before they start.
